social_media.headline: Historic Geomagnetic Storm Recap
social_media.subheadline: Review of the May 10–12 CME Impacts
social_media.summary: The major space weather event associated with Active Region 3664 and multiple CME impacts has ended. No additional significant geomagnetic impacts from this event are expected.

confidence.label: Status
confidence.detail: This is the final Space Weather Summary for this event.

what_we_know: Active Region 3664 produced major flares and multiple Earth-directed CMEs.
Geomagnetic activity reached G3, G4, and G5, with multiple G5 periods.
Solar particle storm conditions reached SP2 during the event.
Solar wind and geomagnetic activity have returned to routine monitoring levels.

footer.left: All event-related products are no longer in effect.
footer.center: Event complete; return to routine monitoring.

visual.alt_text: Operational visualization recapping the May 2024 historic geomagnetic storm and its impacts.
